svg.title: Every individual expanded public slowdown over 20%
svg.desc: Public development only; final independent benchmark failed; no final winner. CPython, C, Rust, and Zig ran the same 8192 calibration-only public cases, 13 paired trials, and 2000 bootstrap draws. Every one of the 5,173 observed substantial slowdowns; no case is hidden. Public manifest SHA-256 c9950c87079ccc1909ba4470ed573b08afe1f275b85a8932cbfe83b547b24f96; public summary SHA-256 d9dd1e712a97d0d1716308e1e468e0c9d2b6d6058e501bccd871492bc66a6b4c. Final speed, final memory, and final candidate ranking: NOT MEASURED. Final winner: NONE.

Every measured substantial loss is named individually; bars use a zero-preserving logarithmic visual scale. Final regressions: NOT MEASURED.
